metadata.name: vmstat
metadata.description: Report virtual memory, processes, and I/O statistics

installation.note: vmstat is commonly available by default (procps or util-linux package)

overview.summary: vmstat reports virtual memory statistics, process counts, and block I/O. It can run once or repeatedly with a delay, helping you spot memory pressure, swap usage, and CPU/IO activity.
when_to_use: Check memory and swap usage at a glance
Monitor process, block I/O, and CPU activity over time

syntax.description: Without arguments, vmstat prints one snapshot. With DELAY (seconds), it repeats; with COUNT, it repeats that many times.

options.description: Display event counters and memory statistics (one-shot)
options.use_case: See detailed memory and event summary

options.description: Switch output unit (k, K, m, M for KB/MB)

examples.title: Single snapshot
examples.description: Print current memory, process, and I/O stats

examples.title: Monitor every 2 seconds
examples.description: Update statistics every 2 seconds until interrupted
examples.use_case: Watch trends in memory and I/O

related_commands.description: Shows memory usage in a simpler format
